description.narrative: The first stage of Albania#s HCFCs Phase-out Management Plan (HPMP) was approved at the 64th Meeting of the Executive Committee in July 2011. The Government of Albania committed to reduce the consumption of HCFCs by 35% from the calculated baseline by the year 2020. The first stage covers the freeze of the HCFCs consumption in 2013-2014, the 10% reduction in 2015-2019 and the 35% reduction in 2020. The first tranche was approved at the 64th Meeting of the Executive Committee in July 2011 in the amount of US$ 45,000 for the lead agency UNIDO and US$ 25,000 for the cooperating agency UNEP not including programme support costs (PSC). The second tranche was approved at the 70th Meeting of the Executive Committee in July 2013 in the amount of US$ 92,000 for UNIDO and US$ 20 ,000 for UNEP, not including PSC. The third tranche was approved at the 75th Meeting of the Executive Committee in November 2015 in the amount of US$ 40,000 for UNIDO and US$ 23,000 for UNEP, not including PSC. A detailed national consumption verification report was submitted with the third tranche. The fourth tranche was approved at the 81st Meeting of the Executive Committee in June 2018 in the amount of US$ 30,000 for UNIDO and US$ 8 ,500 for UNEP, not including PSC.
